exercises.prompt: The second button of your shirt is coming off.
exercises.why: Ordinal numerals are used and declined as Adjectives in both Singular and Plural. In compound ordinal numerals only the last element is actually an ordinal, and only this element is declined. (a) In Russian, as in English, numerators are cardinal and denominators are ordinal numbers. Note that the feminine gender is used: одна вторая, две седьмых, etc. This is because the word «ЧАСТЬ» (part) is implied. (b) Both the numerator and the denominator are declined; the noun to which the fraction refers is always in the Genitive case: *три восьмых дюйма; трёх восьмых дюйма; тремя восьмыми дюйма.* (c) The conjunction «и» is used to link the fraction to a whole number: *3 7/8 — три и семь восьмых.*… — DLI, Lesson 72.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Ordinal numerals are used and declined as Adjectives in both Singular and Plural. (DLI, Lesson 72)
